purpose: Diagnose sensitivity of the frozen geometry-001 hypothesis; no game coefficient fitting or model promotion.
decision_policy: Preserve fit/check split, 0.03 m gate and 600..6000 px focal grid. Never select corner changes or jitter scenarios using held-out outcomes.
noise_model: Independent zero-mean Gaussian x/y pixel perturbations per corner and labeled center in each view. Assumed diagnostic scales, not an empirical error model.
pre_result_commitment: Run all 640 trials and retain failed pose searches. Report conditional residual ranges, not a favorable perturbed model. No passing trial changes the failed baseline acceptance decision.
